items.title: Open every show with one real fact
items.summary: It gives the jokes something to stand on.

items.title: Invite listeners to send in the stories they are sure are made up
Record the same segment twice and keep the better take
items.summary: The second take is almost always calmer and clearer.

items.title: Write the headline last
items.summary: You will know what the piece is really about by then.

items.title: Check one fact twice before it goes out
items.summary: One careful check is worth more than a correction.

items.title: Start a weekly show with a fixed three-part format
items.summary: Structure frees you to be spontaneous inside it.

items.title: Invite a guest who disagrees with you
Turn each episode into a one-page newsletter
items.summary: A second life for the same work.
